1	Learning-Assisted InSAR DEM Enhancement
2	========================================
3	
4	Contest submission for the **[IEEE GRSS 2026 Data Fusion Contest](https://www.grss-ieee.org/community/technical-committees/2026-ieee-grss-data-fusion-contest/)**
5	— *deadline: April 06, 2026.*
6	
7	This repository implements a **stack-aware, self-supervised deep learning pipeline** for improving Interferometric SAR (InSAR) products over large, geometry-diverse Capella Space X-band SAR stacks, with downstream improvements in DEM quality and time-series consistency.
8	
9	---
10	
11	## Overview
12	
13	The contest provides a Capella Space X-band SAR dataset: ~791 SLC collects across 39 AOIs, enabling thousands of interferometric pairs with substantial diversity in acquisition mode, incidence angle, look direction, and orbital geometry.
14	
15	A competitive entry must be **pair-graph-aware** and **geometry-conditioned**. Our approach:
16	
17	1. **Pair-graph construction** — Build a graph (nodes = SLC collects, edges = candidate pairs), score each edge by `Q_ij = 1/(Δt+1) × 1/(1+Δinc)`, compute perpendicular baseline `B_perp` from satellite state vectors, and enumerate closure triplets for network health tracking.
18	2. **Baseline InSAR products** — Sub-pixel coregistration via phase cross-correlation, interferogram formation, coherence estimation, Goldstein-Werner spectral filtering (coherence-adaptive), SNAPHU phase unwrapping.
19	3. **Self-supervised DL enhancement** — A FiLM-conditioned U-Net (`FiLMUNet`) trained without ground-truth labels using Noise2Noise via sub-look splits + closure-consistency + temporal-consistency + fringe-preservation losses. Outputs a denoised complex interferogram + per-pixel log-variance uncertainty.
20	4. **Uncertainty-weighted inversion** — Predicted uncertainty `σ²(p)` weights both SNAPHU unwrapping and SBAS stack inversion.
21	5. **Evaluation** — Five physics-linked contest metrics computed for Goldstein baseline vs. FiLMUNet.
22	
23	---
24	
25	## Contest Metrics
26	
27	| # | Metric | Definition | Target |
28	|---|--------|-----------|--------|
29	| 1 | Triplet closure error | `median|wrap(φ_ab + φ_bc − φ_ac)|` over all complete triplets | ↓ ≥ 30% |
30	| 2 | Unwrap success rate | Fraction of interferograms with ≥ 90% connected unwrap coverage | ↑ ≥ 15 pp |
31	| 3 | Percent usable pairs | Fraction passing coherence > 0.35 + unwrap + closure gates | ↑ ≥ 25 pp |
32	| 4 | DEM NMAD | `1.4826 × median(|e − median(e)|)` over stable terrain | ↓ ≥ 15% |
33	| 5 | Temporal consistency residual | SBAS inversion residual `‖W(Ax − φ̂)‖₂` | ↓ ≥ 20% |
34	
35	**Current baseline values** (Goldstein, 162 processed pairs, Hawaii AOI, 2026-03-18):
36	
37	| Metric | Goldstein | Status |
38	|--------|-----------|--------|
39	| M1 Triplet closure error | 1.018 rad | 62 complete triplets ✓ |
40	| M2 Unwrap success rate | — | Pending SNAPHU |
41	| M3 Usable pairs fraction | 0.000 | Pending FiLMUNet inference |
42	| M4 DEM NMAD | — | Pending reference DEM |
43	| M5 Temporal consistency | 0.050 rad | P=162 > T=138 ✓ |
44	
45	---
46	
47	## Environment
48	
49	This project uses a shared conda environment at `/scratch/gdemil24/hrwsi_s3client/torch-gpu`.
50	
51	```bash
52	# All scripts must be run as:
53	export LD_LIBRARY_PATH=/scratch/gdemil24/hrwsi_s3client/torch-gpu/lib:$LD_LIBRARY_PATH
54	export PYTHONPATH=/scratch/gdemil24/Learning-Assisted-InSAR-DEM-Enhancement
55	conda run --prefix /scratch/gdemil24/hrwsi_s3client/torch-gpu python <script> <args>
56	
57	# Verify GPU + key packages:
58	conda run --prefix /scratch/gdemil24/hrwsi_s3client/torch-gpu python -c "
59	import torch; print('CUDA:', torch.cuda.is_available())
60	import rasterio; print('rasterio:', rasterio.__version__)
61	import boto3, pystac; print('boto3/pystac OK')
62	"
63	```
64	
65	**Installed**: Python 3.10, PyTorch 2.4.0 + CUDA, rasterio, boto3, pystac, numpy, scipy, pandas, matplotlib, pyyaml.
66	
67	To recreate from scratch:
68	```bash
69	conda create -n insar-dem python=3.10
70	conda activate insar-dem
71	pip install torch torchvision --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu121
72	pip install -r requirements.txt
73	pip install -e .
74	pip install boto3 pystac snaphu
75	```
76	
77	---
78	
79	## Data Access
80	
81	Data is on a **public AWS S3 bucket** — no credentials required.
82	
83	| Resource | URL |
84	|----------|-----|
85	| S3 bucket | `s3://capella-open-data/` (region: `us-west-2`) |
86	| STAC catalog | `https://capella-open-data.s3.us-west-2.amazonaws.com/stac/catalog.json` |
87	| Contest collection | `capella-open-data-ieee-data-contest/collection.json` |
88

297	
298	- **Self-supervised only** — no ground-truth clean interferograms are used. Noise2Noise training uses FFT sub-look splits of each SLC acquisition.

300	- **Model output is a denoised interferogram, not a DEM** — absolute DEM requires SNAPHU unwrapping + SBAS inversion downstream.
301	- **Triplet-aware pair selection** — the top-q-score pairs alone form no closed triplets (all Δt=3d; diagonal Δt=6d legs needed). `select_triplet_completing_pairs.py` identifies and adds the minimal set.
302	- **Full pair ID for output directories** — 80-char truncation caused silent data overwrites. Full 104-char pair IDs are used (well under the 255-char filesystem limit).
303	- **AOI-based train/val/test splits** — temporal ordering prevents geographic leakage; no random tile splitting.
